_schema.purpose: Defines the contexts that exist. Which skills belong to a context is NOT stored here — that lives in each skill's frontmatter 'contexts:' list, which is the single source of truth. This file only names and describes the contexts themselves.
_schema.contexts[].name: Display name. Unique, case-sensitive, used verbatim in skill frontmatter.
_schema.contexts[].description: One line the user wrote or accepted, shown when listing contexts.
_schema.contexts[].builtin: Optional boolean. True only for Global, which cannot be renamed or removed.
_schema.activeContext: Not stored here — it is per-machine and lives in user/state.json.
_schema.export: A context is the unit of export for web portals: tools/bundle/build-bundle.mjs takes --context <name> and flattens the persona plus that context's skills into a portal-shaped bundle. Global exports everything. Contexts are therefore also a size-management tool: a user with too much to fit inside claude.ai's instruction limit splits their work into narrower contexts and exports those.
_schema.semantics: All skills remain available in every context. The active context biases navigation, suggestions, and ambiguity resolution — it never restricts access. Global applies no bias.

contexts.name: Global
contexts.description: Everything at once — no bias toward any one area
